teaser: Where to send a publisher new to the newsroom: a section placed by rule, with features as they ship, that keeps itself current as the site changes.
core_idea: A publishers page written once falls behind a site that changes daily, so the newsroom gets sections: one audience's view with five pieces to start with, the latest, the features they can use with when each shipped, and every relevant article placed by rule from the existing classification, each saying why; building it exposed loose classification, fixed as rules with reasons.

Every fix here is a rule with a reason, in a file anyone can read

figures.caption: A section for publishers, and how it keeps itself current. Three inputs: the desks and controlled subjects every article already has, the section's own file of rules and the editor's words, and a register of the site's features with when each shipped. One build step places every article into the section's streams, says which rule placed it, and writes the page and its JSON twin. The page: five pieces to start with, the latest, the features a publisher can use today, and four streams of articles.
